definition.hw_sd: sd over rows of ln(row RMS); identical to kmix_bridge_v1_1 'hw' (Figure 1a, Figure 3)
definition.hw_iqr_log10_rms2: IQR over rows of log10(row RMS^2); pre-registered IVN J2 statistic (ivn_j1_j3_hw_v1)
definition.aggregation: per family: median over 6 layers at each terminal step, then median over the terminal window (keys hw_sd/...); 'pooled18' = median over the 18 terminal matrices, the aggregation used for every bar of Figure 2(c)
